final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS hand_count FROM appearances AS a INNER JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(hand_count) AS total_count, AVG(hand_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.hand_count, 1.0 * h.hand_count / t.total_count AS share, 1.0 * h.hand_count / t.average_count AS count_over_average FROM hand_counts AS h INNER JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.average_count IS NOT NULL
